title: Đề thi giữa kì 1 Tiếng Anh 12 số 03 – 50 câu (mã đề 225)
description: Đề thi giữa kì 1 Tiếng Anh 12 gồm 50 câu trắc nghiệm làm trong 45 phút, chấm theo thang điểm 10. Đề phủ đủ các dạng: sắp xếp đoạn văn, điền vào chỗ trống trong bài viết và thông báo, đọc hiểu bài Green Living at Home, cùng phần từ vựng và ngữ pháp về văn hoá, môi trường. Mỗi câu đều có đáp án và giải thích bằng tiếng Việt.
subject: tieng-anh

questions.partName: Phần I. Sắp xếp đoạn văn
questions.content:
**Choose the best arrangement of sentences to make a cohesive and coherent text.**

> a. The first stage is commonly referred to as the honeymoon phase.
> b. Then people experience frustration stage as the excitement of being in a new environment disappears.
> c. People who experience culture shock may go through four phases.
> d. During the acceptance stage - the final one, people are better able to experience and enjoy their new home.
> e. The third stage is the adaptation stage when people feel more at home in their new surroundings.

Which order is correct?
questions.explanation: Câu (c) nêu chủ đề bốn giai đoạn của sốc văn hoá, rồi đến lượt các câu giới thiệu giai đoạn thứ nhất, giai đoạn tiếp theo, giai đoạn thứ ba và giai đoạn cuối, nên trật tự c - a - b - e - d là mạch lạc nhất.

questions.partName: Phần I. Sắp xếp đoạn văn
questions.content:
**Choose the best arrangement of sentences to make a cohesive and coherent text.**

> a. Despite facing failures and being removed from his own company, he returned and led Apple to even greater success.
> b. Jobs was also known for his unique leadership style, which demanded excellence and pushed his team to think differently.
> c. Steve Jobs was one of the most successful entrepreneurs of the modern era. He co-founded Apple and transformed it into one of the most valuable companies in the world.
> d. Although he passed away in 2011, his influence on design and technology continues to shape the modern world.
> e. His vision for innovative products, such as the iPhone and iPad, changed the way people use technology.

Which order is correct?
questions.explanation: Câu (c) giới thiệu chung về Steve Jobs và Apple, (a) tiếp tục chuỗi sự nghiệp với thất bại rồi quay lại, (b) bổ sung phong cách lãnh đạo, (e) mở rộng sang tầm nhìn sản phẩm và (d) khép lại bằng di sản về design and technology.

> *How to Use Plastic Properly*
>
> Plastic has become an important part of modern life, but it also causes many environmental problems, ...(13)... Every year, millions of plastic bottles and bags are thrown away and end up in the ocean. People can help reduce this problem ...(14)...
>
> First, we should always reuse plastic items, ...(15)... For example, a plastic bottle can be used many times instead of buying a new one. Second, we should recycle plastic waste by putting it in the correct bin, ...(16)... Many countries now have recycling systems to help protect the environment.
>
> However, we also need to reduce our plastic use whenever possible. Some people still use plastic straws and cups every day, ...(17)... options.text: but it is never recycled properly
so it helps clean the environment
because it makes our lives easier

questions.explanation: Vế trước đã nêu nhựa gây nhiều vấn đề môi trường nên chỗ trống cần mệnh đề nối tiếp hậu quả: “and this creates serious pollution” dẫn thẳng sang bằng chứng “millions of plastic bottles and bags are thrown away...”. A (but it is never recycled properly) ngược quan hệ tương phản, C (because it makes our lives easier) gắn nguyên nhân sai chỗ, B trái nghĩa.

questions.partName: Phần III. Từ vựng và ngữ pháp
questions.content:
**Choose the best answer.**

Some immigrants said they were afraid of losing their ______
questions.explanation: Người nhập cư lo đánh mất bản sắc văn hoá của chính mình, nên cultural identities (số nhiều, ứng với nhiều người) hợp ngữ cảnh; cultural diversity là sự đa văn hoá của cộng đồng chứ không phải thứ một người có thể mất.

questions.partName: Phần III. Từ vựng và ngữ pháp
questions.content:
**Choose the best answer.**

The decision to reduce ______ carbon emissions was seen as a major step toward sustainable development.
questions.explanation: “reduce carbon emissions” là cụm cố định nói về khí thải nói chung, phía sau không có ngữ hạn chế nào nên không cần mạo từ; a/an loại vì carbon emissions là danh từ số nhiều.

questions.partName: Phần III. Từ vựng và ngữ pháp

______ training helps soldiers become stronger and more disciplined.
questions.explanation: Military training (huấn luyện quân sự) là cụm từ cố định và là hoạt động duy nhất trong bốn phương án dành cho soldiers.

Every citizen should ______ their duty to protect the environment and keep their community clean.

questions.content:

In today's globalized world, students should learn how to ______ new cultural environments.

questions.partName: Phần III. Từ vựng và ngữ pháp
questions.content:

We live in a ______ world where people from different backgrounds share their traditions, languages, and ideas.

questions.content:

questions.partName: Phần IV. Đọc hiểu
questions.content:
**Read the passage and choose the best answer to each of the following questions.**

> *Green Living at Home*
>
> Many people think that protecting the environment requires big actions, but green living can start right at home. By changing a few daily habits, families can save energy, reduce waste, and live a healthier life. Every small step - from turning off lights to recycling paper - can help make the planet greener.
>
> One simple way to live green is to save electricity. People should switch off lights and electronic devices when they are not in use. Using energy-saving bulbs and unplugging chargers after use are also good habits. In some homes, solar panels are installed to produce clean energy from sunlight. These actions help lower electricity bills and reduce pollution.
>
> Water saving is another important part of green living. Many people let the tap run while brushing their teeth or washing dishes. If they turn it off, they can save many liters of water each day. Collecting rainwater to water plants and using a bucket instead of a hose are also useful ideas. Small changes like these protect our water resources.
>
> Recycling is easy but very effective. Instead of throwing everything away, we can sort items into separate bins for paper, glass, and plastic. Some old clothes can be donated or reused as cleaning cloths. By recycling, we use materials again and reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills.
>
> Finally, buying local and eco-friendly products supports the environment. Local food does not travel far, which reduces fuel use and air pollution. Eco-friendly products are made from natural or recycled materials and are safer for both people and nature. When we choose them, we help build a more sustainable future.

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: Ways to save money at home
Simple actions for green living at home

questions.explanation: Toàn bài liệt kê từng việc nhỏ mỗi gia đình làm được tại nhà (tiết kiệm điện, tiết kiệm nước, tái chế, mua sản phẩm thân thiện), nên ý chính là simple actions for green living at home.
